description: Return the computed value of each requested CSS property (kebab-case, e.g. "background-color") for the element identified by ref or selector (max 50 properties). Only the requested properties are returned, never the full declaration. Returns: { ok, session_id, style: { <prop>: <value> } }. Errors: REF_NOT_FOUND / SELECTOR_NO_MATCH (carries similar_refs), TRANSPORT_UNSUPPORTED, NOT_RUNNING, BAD_ARGUMENT.

properties.description: CSS properties to read, kebab-case (e.g. ["display", "background-color"]). Max 50.

ref.description: Element ref from a snapshot (resolves to [data-sw-ref="N"]). Provide ref OR selector.

selector.description: CSS selector. Provide ref OR selector, not both.

sessionId.description: Target session id. Omit when a single session is running.

name: electron_get_computed_style
title: Get computed CSS properties
